caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile, likely a blanket, laid out flat with visible fringe on the bottom edge. The textile features a checkered pattern consisting of alternating squares and rectangles in dark navy blue, teal blue, and a muted red-orange color. The pattern is complex, with geometric shapes such as rectangles, squares, lines, and motifs reminiscent of stylized plant or abstract forms, arranged symmetrically. The squares and stripes of red-orange are placed intermittently between larger blocks and bands of blue and teal, forming a grid-like intersection throughout the fabric. The fringe at the bottom combines the same blue, teal, and red-orange threads, creating a blended effect. The background is a plain off-white, and the entire textile appears to be centered on the page without any other objects in the drawing.
title: Coverlet - Pine Tree Border
